acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:f46e34d6-.title: Senior Product Manager, Design Systems
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:f46e34d6-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As the Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for how every team builds Vanta's interface. Your mission is to build the horizontal tooling that lets product, engineering, and design teams create consistent, high-quality user experiences faster, so they can spend more of their time on their customers. To be successful, you’ll need to have a high level of product taste and be able to set and hold the line for high quality and easy to use products. All while working closely with your engineering and design manager partners. You'll be part of Vanta's Platform organization, which builds the foundational primitives and craft layer the rest of the product is built on. This is the first dedicated Design Systems PM role at Vanta, so you'll help shape the function itself, not just the roadmap. It's a high-autonomy, highly cross-functional role at the center of how Vanta looks, feels, and scales. What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta: - Own the vision and roadmap for the frontend, spanning the design system and the front-end platform, and ladder durable platform investments to company initiatives so design and engineering can focus on customers. - Evolve our design system from a broad component library into smaller, composable building blocks with consistent APIs, including making components first-class for AI and LLM-driven experiences. - Drive accessibility and internationalization programs to their committed milestones, including global-scale localization and meeting accessibility standards. - Partner with our AI team to enable the agentic patterns product teams need to build the next generation of Vanta experiences. - Run go-to-market and adoption for design-system changes, and lead ongoing quality and "paper cuts" triage as the craft team for the entire product. - Partner closely with your engineering and design leads as a triad, continuously prioritizing the highest-impact work across a wide surface area. - Look 12 to 18 months ahead at how the design system and front-end platform scale with Vanta, including AI-native use. How to be successful in this role: - Have 4-8+ years of product management experience, with real ownership of a design system, frontend platform, or developer and design experience that served many teams. - Bring craft and taste at scale. You have a clear point of view on quality, you can scale it across many teams, and you earn craft credibility with senior design and product leaders. - Have a builder's mindset. You're not an engineer, but you're hands-on: you spin up prototypes and demos and build with the same component building blocks that your team ships. - Collaborate horizontally and build trust. You serve every product team as an internal platform, build consensus across the company, and you're the partner other teams are glad to see at their door. - Think in systems. You reason about how components, tokens, patterns, and front-end infrastructure fit together and cascade across every product surface. - Tell the story. You translate why front-end and design-system investment matters into clear business value for leadership and cross-functional partners. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100%

Dziś zapraszamy Cię do procesu rekrutacyjnego dla Bnewable. Bnewable to niezależna belgijska firma energetyczna, specjalizująca się w magazynowaniu energii i zarządzaniu energią. O produkcie: na co dzień m. in. tworzą platformę Voltana, która służy do zarządzania energią i jest oparta na AI, optymaliząc stacjonarne systemy magazynowania energii w bateriach dla dużych klientów komercyjnych i przemysłowych w Belgii i Niemczech. A dziś do tej współpracy chcą zaprosić osobę na stanowisko Support & QA Engineera z min. 4 latami doświadczenia w obszarze wsparcia użytkowników/czek systemów oraz testów. B2). Główne wyzwanie: Nowa osoba w roli Support & QA Engineera będzie odpowiedzialna za bycie pierwszą linią kontaktu dla wewnętrznych użytkowników/czek platformy Voltana oraz odpowiadanie za troubleshooting site'ów, a także testy gwarantując jakość i bezpieczeństwo systemów na co dzień. locations: UFC: 2607 S 3200 W, West Valley City, UT 84119
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f90.description: At Backcountry, our mission is to connect people to their passions. Our four online stores—Backcountry, Competitive Cyclist, MotoSport and, SteepandCheap—aim to supply our customers with the gear, knowledge, and inspiration necessary to get out there and chase down life’s greatest moments. We do this by providing the biggest and best assortment of premium outdoor products, superior shopping experience, personalized Gearhead expertise, lightning-fast and accurate fulfillment, and inspirational, informative, and community-centered content. This is a Seasonal Position with a maximum employment period of six (6) months. We offer three full-time shift options; part-time positions are not available. Backcountry has an amazing opportunity for highly motivated individual to join our Warehouse team as a Merchandise Processor! If you are fast on your feet, and love handling all the cool gear we sell from the time it enters our doors to the time it leaves, this job could be for you…consider it more like pre shopping and less like work! This is a physically active role that keeps you on your feet and moving throughout your shift. You'll spend your time packing orders and loading packages into trailers, which means you should be comfortable with constant standing, frequent bending, and repetitive lifting. If you're someone who prefers hands-on work over sitting at a desk, this is a great fit. Three Shifts Available: · AM- Mon-Fri, 6:00a-2:30p, $16.00/hr. · PM- Mon-Fri, 2:30p-11:00p, $15/hr + $1.85/hrshift differential = $17.85/hr. · WKN- Sat-Mon, 8:00a-8:30p, $15/hr + $2.00/hrshift differential = $18.00/hr. - Our shifts are NOT flexible, meaning if you are unable to work the entire shift, we are unable to hire you. Seasonal Position Info: · Yes! We do often convert our high-performing seasonal employees to regular status, these decisions are based on business demands and performance. · Seasonal positions are not eligible for benefits; however, you do get to participate in our employee discount perk and it's a good one! Overtime: Occasionally, overtime may be required to support operational demands. When this happens, overtime is typically scheduled as follows: · AM Shift: May begin up to 1 hour earlier than the standard start time · PM Shift: May extend up to 1 hour beyond the usual end time · Weekend Shift: May include an additional day, as shifts are already 10–12 hours Please note that all scheduling, including overtime, is subject to change based on business needs and volume fluctuations. We appreciate your flexibility and commitment in helping us meet customer expectations. Blackout Dates & Holiday Information: Our warehouse will be closed on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Years Day; and we typically work shorter hours on Christmas Eve and New Years Eve. To support our busiest season, our Backcountry fulfillment centers have a blackout period for time off requests. The blackout period is typically from November 10th through December 23rd. During this blackout period, time off requests cannot be approved.

With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. About the Role We are seeking a highly technical, data-driven Growth Engineer to help scale our product and expand key user metrics across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. Growth Engineering sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and marketing—leveraging code, experimentation, and analytics to uncover opportunities and deliver measurable impact. What You’ll Do - Drive Experimentation & Optimization - Design, implement, and analyze rapid A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and improve key KPIs. - Identify bottlenecks in user funnels and develop technical solutions to improve conversion rates throughout the user lifecycle. Build and Scale Growth Features - Build growth-oriented product features such as onboarding flows, referral systems, and automated engagement loops. - Develop scalable code and infrastructure that supports growth initiatives and experimentation frameworks. Leverage Data & Metrics - Collaborate with data teams to instrument tracking, build dashboards, and derive insights from user behavior data. - Use SQL and analytics tools to deeply analyze cohorts, engagement metrics, and experiment outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with product managers, designers, marketers, and data scientists to align on growth goals and execution plans. - Translate business goals into technical requirements and implement pragmatic solutions that drive sustainable growth. Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience). - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. - Strong programming skills (e.g., Node, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go). - Experience with data analysis and database query languages (e.g., SQL). - Familiarity with instrumentation, analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude), and experimentation frameworks. - Comfort with designing and interpreting experiments grounded in statistical thinking. What Success Looks Like: - Measurable improvements in user acquisition, onboarding, retention, and activation via experiments. - Scalable, well-instrumented growth capabilities that reduce manual effort and increase velocity. - Growth strategies and systems that become integrated into product development and long-term planning. Why Join Us - This is a rare opportunity to be among the first engineers on a newly formed Growth team, with significant ownership and influence over both technical direction and product outcomes. You’ll be working on a product that scaled from ~2M to 250M users in under a year, operating in a massive and still largely untapped market. The impact of your work will be visible, measurable, and foundational to how the company grows next. - Impact how engineering and product teams scale solutions for millions of users. - Competitive compensation and benefits tailored to growth-focused engineers. This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability 🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave 🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays 🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only) 📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend 🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment 🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only) 🚀 Quarterly Team

Experience developing vendor evaluation criteria, RFP materials, demonstration scripts, and requirements traceability documentation. Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to connect business objectives to detailed requirements. Comfortable providing on-call support and handling non-project requirements, enhancements, and operational requests. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7cf92fbc-de1c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Analyst based in United States. This is a high-impact senior individual contributor role within a data-driven product organization. You will own analytics for Wishlists and Celebrations, helping shape experiences that extend customer engagement beyond the newborn phase. The role combines product analytics, experimentation, instrumentation, and business analysis across a multi-sided ecosystem of users and partners. You will build KPI frameworks and measurement strategies for evolving product surfaces, often starting from the ground up. Your insights will directly influence product priorities, experimentation roadmaps, retention strategies, and long-term business value. You will also help advance AI-assisted analytics practices and raise the analytical standards across the broader Data organization. This is an opportunity for an experienced analyst to operate with significant autonomy, strategic influence, and end-to-end ownership. Own end-to-end analytics for Wishlists and Celebrations, including occasion-based gifting, event pages, and host and guest journeys. Define success metrics for emerging product surfaces by building, maintaining, and evolving KPI trees and comprehensive measurement frameworks. Design, execute, and analyze experiments that improve list creation, guest participation, repeat engagement, and overall product effectiveness. Analyze the behaviors and needs of registrants, hosts, gift givers, and partners, translating complex multi-sided user journeys into actionable insights. Quantify how occasion-based experiences contribute to retention, repeat engagement, and long-term customer value. Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks, and AI-assisted analytical artifacts that provide clear visibility into product and business performance. Use AI tools throughout the analytical workflow to accelerate analysis, improve code quality, automate repetitive work, and increase individual productivity. Partner closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to influence product strategy and guide decisions through rigorous analysis. Conduct program and business analysis when needed, adapting analytical approaches to evaluate broader initiatives and their financial or operational impact. Lead win/loss and retrospective analyses where relevant to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Contribute to data organization initiatives, analytical best practices, and the development of AI-assisted analytics capabilities. Requirements 6+ years of relevant experience in product analytics or a closely related analytical discipline. Mastery-level SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing large-scale datasets containing millions to billions of rows. Strong expertise in event instrumentation, clickstream data, tracking architecture, event auditing, and KPI development. Extensive hands-on experience with experimentation, including statistical testing, experimental design, A/B testing, and interpreting ambiguous or imperfect results. Demonstrated ability to connect user behavior and product performance with broader business outcomes, retention, and lifetime value. Experience using AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, Devin, or similar technologies as an established part of an analytical workflow. Strong understanding of both product analytics and program or business analytics, with the ability to adapt methodologies to different business questions. Experience with modern experimentation and product analytics platforms such as LaunchDarkly and Amplitude, as well as data modeling and visualization tools such as dbt, Hex, or Sigma.
